analyst_note: BACKEND_PREFLIGHT=CREDITS_EXHAUSTED (Batch 11, one-shot). Intelligence layer remains UNMEASURED.

defects.title: Manifest join dead for every real company
defects.observed_state: Analysis resolves the LEGAL name ('Cloudflare, Inc.') -> key 'cloudflare-inc', which matches no manifest id. Dossier filed under an unfindable key with cohort='' and manifest_version=''.
defects.expected_invariant: A company in the validation universe is filed under its manifest company_id and carries its cohort and manifest version.
defects.evidence: wave smoke run: dossier built=true, telemetry dossiers_persisted=1, but DossierStore.latest('cloudflare') was None.
defects.why_invisible: Empty cohort is indistinguishable from a company legitimately outside the universe; nothing raises. Batch 9's join test passed only because its fixture name was bare 'Shopify'.

defects.title: An infrastructure failure is explained to the founder as thin evidence
defects.observed_state: ResultState.FAILED (exhausted API balance) rendered as 'every source here is the company's own account. Independent reporting would strengthen this.'
defects.expected_invariant: Only states the EVIDENCE caused may be explained in terms of evidence. FAILED and RETRIEVAL_BLOCKED are about us.
defects.evidence: baseline wave: 6/10 companies reached FAILED; result_state_detail blamed source composition in every case.
defects.why_invisible: The text is plausible and specific, so a founder acts on it by collecting more sources, which cannot help.
defects.rerun_results: FAILED now keeps ResultState.EXPLANATION[FAILED]; AST test pins the call-site gate

defects.title: Analyst logged the exception type only, discarding the diagnosis
defects.observed_state: 'analyst call failed: BadRequestError' - identical output for exhausted credit, unknown model, oversized request, malformed schema.
defects.expected_invariant: A failure a wave hits on every company must say why from its own output.
defects.evidence: smoke run produced two BadRequestError lines with no message; the real cause (credit balance) needed a separate manual probe.
defects.rerun_results: provider message now captured per company in record.diagnostics

defects.title: Redirect policy refuses same-company subdomains that candidate approval accepts
defects.observed_state: validation.redirect_allowed permits the same registrable domain (line 79) then requires exact host equality (line 83), so cloudflare.com -> blog.cloudflare.com and stripe.com -> docs.stripe.com fail as 'unsafe_redirect'. same_domain(), used to APPROVE candidates, accepts those same hosts.
defects.expected_invariant: Approval and redirect-following agree on what counts as the same company.
defects.evidence: baseline: 2 unsafe_redirect failures, both same-company subdomains; 'strategy' family missing for 8/10 companies and blog/docs are where strategy content lives.
defects.rerun_results: unsafe_redirect 2->0; cloudflare 9->10 docs (6->7 families), stripe 7->8, bank-of-america 3->4 families. Cohort yield 39%->40%. HONEST SCOPE: recovered exactly the two refused subdomain redirects. It was NOT the main cause of missing strategy evidence (8->7 of 10).
defects.note: Not fixed in this batch: Class D, and the fix touches an SSRF-adjacent guard that deserves its own security review.

defects.title: Fetch timeouts drive p95 to ~10x p50
defects.observed_state: All 20 cohort timeouts fall on two companies (10 each). Those two are the only runs over 150s; p50=18.5s, p95=178.9s.
defects.expected_invariant: A refused or dead source should cost a bounded, small amount of wall time.
defects.evidence: baseline: amd fetch 83s/compose 67s with 11 failures; mckinsey fetch 82s/compose 51s with 13 failures; every other company <30s total.
defects.rerun_results: timeouts 20->4 (16 became cheap host_unreachable). AMD 178.9s->45.8s, McKinsey 160.3s->44.7s. Cohort wall 467s->221s (-53%), max 178.9->45.8. p50 18.5->19.1 (unchanged, correct: the breaker only affects dead hosts). NO EVIDENCE LOST: AMD 3->3 docs, McKinsey 1->1.

defects.title: Strategy and customer evidence is systematically not retrieved
defects.observed_state: After BW10-004/005 the cohort yield is 40% (56/140). Failures are dominated by http_status=62, UNCHANGED by either fix. Redirect policy accounted for 2 and timeouts cost latency, not documents.
defects.expected_invariant: A large listed company should yield more than 4 of 14 approved sources.
defects.evidence: baseline source_health across the cohort; 62 http_status (mostly 403/404) and 20 timeouts out of 86 failures.
defects.note: THE YIELD STORY IS HTTP 403/404, not redirects and not timeouts. Every one of the ten hits at least one 403; 6 of 10 also hit 404s. The exact 403:404 split is NOT YET MEASURED — the wave recorded a deduped message SET, so 'which' was visible and 'how many' was not. A counter now ships in the runner; Batch 12's rerun populates it. 403 (we are blocked: user-agent/robots) and 404 (we asked for the wrong URL: discovery) are different defects with different fixes and must not be merged.

defects.title: An absent market snapshot counts as a contract mismatch in telemetry
defects.observed_state: telemetry contract_mismatch=1 per company because market_unavailable() carries the default contract_state CONTRACT_INCOMPATIBLE.
defects.expected_invariant: A snapshot that was never published is UNAVAILABLE, not incompatible.
defects.evidence: baseline telemetry: contract_mismatch=1 for every company though no market snapshot exists in this deployment.
defects.note: Cosmetic today; would misreport bridge health once a market engine publishes. Still open; unchanged this batch.

defects.title: The wave recorded failure messages as a deduped set, hiding counts
defects.observed_state: source_health.failure_messages is a set capped at 6, so 62 http_status failures could not be split into 403 vs 404.
defects.expected_invariant: A failure taxonomy used to choose the next repair must carry counts, not just membership.
defects.evidence: Batch 11 analysis could name which statuses occurred and not how many; the 403/404 split determines whether the next fix is bot-blocking or discovery.
defects.rerun_results: http_status_counts ships in the runner; populated by the next wave.
